William & Mary, one of the nation’s most historic and best colleges, may have solved the entire eligibility scandal that’s been rocking the sport all summer. What if teams simply scored more points than the teams with questionably eligible players. 🤔

Early entry for the most insane eligibility story of the year:
• Pat McQuaide redshirted as Kent State in 2021, played at a JuCo in 2022, and 3 FCS seasons in 2023-25.
• Villanova said he should be eligible for the 2026 season as he’s had 3 NCAA years
• NCAA says yes, but the Patriot League, which they literally just joined, said no
• Villanova sues, and just an hour before the game, a judge rules that he’s allowed to play
• He throws a pick with 0:05 left in a tie game and William & Mary kicks a FG for an extraordinary comeback
Don’t show @Pontifex.
William & Mary trailed Villanova by double digits with 0:49 to play. They won in regulation!!
